deals.headline: Kingdom of Bahrain takes 20% of Paris FC
deals.source_name: Sport Buzz Business (quoting the club's communiqué)
deals.summary: The Kingdom of Bahrain became Paris FC's first foreign shareholder in June 2020 with a 20% stake; no price was published. Bahrain does not appear in the shareholding the club published on 29 November 2024.

deals.headline: BRI Sports Holdings buys 10% of Paris FC through a capital increase
deals.investor: BRI Sports Holdings (Allirajah Subaskaran, founder of Lyca Mobile)
deals.source_name: Sport Buzz Business (quoting the club's communiqué)
deals.summary: Paris FC announced that BRI Sports Holdings, owned by Lyca Mobile founder Allirajah Subaskaran, had joined its capital and board through a capital increase giving it 10%; Lycamobile also became a major sponsor. BRI held 7.2% after the November 2024 Agache/Red Bull deal.

deals.headline: Arnault family's Agache takes control of Paris FC with 52.4%
deals.summary: Paris FC completed its change of shareholders on 29 November 2024: Agache Sport 52.4%, Red Bull 10.6%, Alter Paris 29.8% and BRI 7.2%, with a new board reflecting the Arnault family's majority; Pierre Ferracci stayed as president. No price was published (Sportune lists the cost as 'non communiqué'). franceinfo reported Ferracci's ~30% would pass to the majority owners by 2027.

deals.headline: Red Bull takes 10.6% of Paris FC alongside the Arnault family
deals.summary: Red Bull, owner of RB Leipzig and Red Bull Salzburg, entered Paris FC as a 10.6% minority shareholder in the same transaction that gave Agache Sport control; No price was published.

name: Paris FC
notes: Revenue and P&L are the DNCG's published 2024/25 accounts (Paris FC SASP + Association, season to 30 June 2025, when the club was in Ligue 2; tickets were free that season), in thousands of euros converted to full units; the first Ligue 1 season's accounts (2025/26) are due from the DNCG in spring 2027. The same accounts show cash of EUR 78.9m, shareholder current accounts of EUR 95.0m, financial debts of EUR 2.0m and a EUR 33.5m net loss at 30 June 2025 (no net-debt figure is stated). Stadium capacity is the City of Paris's rounded figure (20,000). No valuation or deal price has been published for the 2024 transaction. The company registry lists Antoine, Alexandre and Frédéric Arnault, Oliver Mintzlaff and Mario Gomez among the directors. The front-of-shirt sponsor for 2026/27, attendance and social-follower counts with dates were not found on citable pages (the LFP says Paris FC's attendance rose 26% in 2025/26).

owners.name: Alter Paris (holding presided by Pierre Ferracci)

ownership_summary: Since 29 November 2024 the Arnault family's holding Agache, through Agache Sport, has owned 52.4% of Paris FC SASP, with Red Bull 10.6%, Alter Paris (the holding presided by club president Pierre Ferracci) 29.8% and BRI Sports Holdings (Allirajah Subaskaran, Lycamobile) 7.2%. franceinfo reported that Ferracci's roughly 30% is to pass to the new majority shareholders by 2027; the Kingdom of Bahrain, a 20% shareholder since June 2020, is not among the shareholders listed in November 2024.
